hook.name: SPRMFeeHook
hook.description: Charges a fixed 3% fee on every swap in a dedicated SPRM/SPCX pool, always collected in SPCX (the non-SPRM currency), applied via BeforeSwapDelta and AfterSwapDelta depending on trade direction. Also gates trading until a fee recipient is set by the owner, and authorizes all SPRM settlements through the ISPRMGatedToken interface on every swap and liquidity change.
